other_failure_modes.name: Look-ahead bias in feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: Using linear interpolation on time-series features uses future information to impute past or present values, which would not be available in a real production forecasting scenario.

summary: The agent successfully implements data cleaning, temporal feature engineering, and trains a LightGBM model. However, it critically fails to respect the temporal nature of the dataset by using randomized K-Fold cross-validation and applying linear interpolation that introduces severe look-ahead bias and data leakage.
